components.title: compliant-s3
components.description: Reusable Terraform pattern for an AWS S3 primary bucket plus a dedicated access-log bucket. Hardcodes server-side encryption, versioning, public access block, access logging, and required compliance tags.
components.purpose: Provide a compliant-by-default S3 primitive that any team can adopt with three lines of consumer Terraform.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by this module.

implemented-requirements.description: AES-256 server-side encryption via a customer-managed KMS key is enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Public access is explicitly denied on every vector (ACLs, bucket policy) via aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Access to the primary bucket is logged to a dedicated log-delivery bucket via aws_s3_bucket_logging, giving each request record the who/what/when/where content AU-3 requires.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: Object versioning is enabled via aws_s3_bucket_versioning, preserving prior object states for recovery and audit as a required configuration setting. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.
